in_scope.name: Faizal
in_scope.other_work: At night I look after the CCTV and the access-card system for the building where I work. When a camera goes offline I check the cables and restart the recorder. During the day I help my brother's printing shop keep its five computers running and install the software the designers need.

in_scope.name: Grace
in_scope.other_work: I am the person everyone at my office calls when the internet is down. I check the router and the switches, find which cable or setting is wrong and fix it. I also create email accounts for new staff and set up their laptops. Last month I moved all our shared files to OneDrive and showed everyone how to use it.

in_scope.name: Lokman
in_scope.other_work: I sell second-hand laptops online. Before I sell one I test the battery and the hard disk, replace parts that are failing, and install a fresh copy of Windows with the drivers. I answer buyers' questions on WhatsApp when they cannot connect to their wifi.

in_scope.name: Kavin
in_scope.other_work: I manage the network and security for my cousin's small accounting firm. I set up the firewall rules, keep the antivirus up to date and check the logs every week for anything unusual. I also make sure the backups to the cloud finish every night.

in_scope.name: Hakim
in_scope.other_work: I write small games in Unity in my spare time and publish them on itch.io. I plan each game's levels, code the player controls in C# and fix the bugs players report. I keep my projects in Git and write a short changelog for every update.

in_scope.name: Suresh
in_scope.other_work: I help a small NGO keep its WordPress website working. I update the plugins, fix pages that break after updates, and add new pages when they run a campaign. I also built them a simple donation form that sends the details to a spreadsheet.

in_scope.name: Farhana
in_scope.other_work: I test mobile apps for a crowd-testing platform. I follow the test cases, try to break the app in other ways, and write bug reports with screenshots and the steps to reproduce them. Sometimes I write simple automated tests in Python with Selenium.

in_scope.name: Jason
in_scope.other_work: I built a booking system for my uncle's homestay with Laravel and MySQL. Guests pick their dates on the website and the system checks which rooms are free. I designed the database tables and wrote the code that sends a confirmation email.

in_scope.name: Nurul
in_scope.other_work: Every month I prepare the accounts for three small shops in my taman. I enter their sales and purchase receipts into a spreadsheet, match the totals against their bank statements and prepare a profit and loss statement. In April I help them fill in their income tax forms.

in_scope.name: Ravi
in_scope.other_work: I run the numbers for my family's durian orchard. I track the cost of fertiliser, labour and transport against what we earn each season, and I worked out which buyers give us the best price. I made a chart showing profit by season so my father can decide whether to expand.

in_scope.name: Chong
in_scope.other_work: I handle accounts receivable for a small printing company two evenings a week. I issue invoices, record the payments that come in and send reminders to customers who are late. At month end I prepare an aging report for the owner.

in_scope.name: Amalina
in_scope.other_work: I review loan applications for a credit cooperative as a volunteer. I check each member's payslips and bank statements, work out how much they can afford to repay and write a short recommendation for the committee. I also keep the register of outstanding loans up to date.

out_of_scope.name: Rosnah
out_of_scope.other_work: I run a small nasi lemak stall on weekends. I cook the rice and sambal early in the morning, serve customers and handle the cash. I buy ingredients from the pasar every Friday and note down what I spend.

out_of_scope.name: Iman
out_of_scope.other_work: I design logos and wedding cards for clients I find on Instagram. I meet each client to understand what they want, sketch two or three ideas and refine the one they choose. I send an invoice when the final files are delivered.

out_of_scope.name: Zainal
out_of_scope.other_work: I do home wiring jobs with my uncle. I install ceiling fans and power points, test circuits for faults and replace broken switches. I quote the price to the customer before we start and collect the payment.

out_of_scope.name: Aminah
out_of_scope.other_work: I teach Quran and Jawi classes to children at our surau. I plan each week's lessons, check every child's reading and talk to parents about their progress. I keep the attendance list and collect the small monthly fee.
